historicalCanonicalBodyReadableC.repairNeeded: In error-exposure.js, only update existing.phase during reconciliation if the caller wrapper provides an explicit, valid item.phase string. Do not allow a fallback or intrinsic err.phase from an unannotated caller wrapper to clobber an already-recorded explicit phase.
historicalCanonicalBodyReadableC.mechanism: In ingestPreexistingErrors, when a caller errorLedger item lacks an explicit phase property, resolveWrapperMeta falls back to err.phase || `${phase}:errorLedger`. If the referenced error was already recorded earlier in the ledger with an authoritative explicit phase (e.g. 'portable:close'), reconcileEntry executes because existing.phase !== p, overwriting the recorded phase with the fallback/intrinsic phase and re-serializing the entry. This regresses the explicit recorded phase on exposure.
